avoid_for: Dense operational dashboards, dark-mode products, consumer retail, or any context needing heavy chrome or saturated multi-color surfaces — the editorial serif voice, whisper-thin shadows, 97% achromatic palette, and oversized rounded cards are a magazine-spread register, not a data-dense cockpit.
best_for: AI / analytics / data-infrastructure product landing pages that want an editorial, magazine-spread feel — oversized italicized serif headlines on white paper, one peach accent card, pill controls, and floating product UI artifacts (region tables, activation charts, AI composer) instead of a dashboard shell.
name: Steep
palette_voice: A near-monochrome white paper canvas (#ffffff) with quiet gray layers (Mist #f2f2f3, Fog #fafafb) carries everything; Ink Black (#17191c) is the only dark surface — body text, nav, and the filled pill button; a single warm Blush Peach (#fbe1d1) accent card paired with Sienna Brown (#5d2a1a) ink reads like kraft paper and appears at most once per page; Slate/Ash/Smoke grays handle muted text. Color is rationed to functional emphasis — everything else is achromatic.
signature_moves: Oversized Signifier weight-400 serif headlines (44/64/90px) with tight negative tracking and the occasional italicized phrase — the serif whispers authority rather than shouting in bold

Floating product-artifact cards (region table, activation chart, AI composer) scattered around hero headlines on white with hairline borders and barely-there 10% shadows — the only elements allowed visible elevation
The single Blush Peach (#fbe1d1) accent card with Sienna Brown ink — the one chromatic surface in the system, used as a rare kraft-paper editorial callout
Filled Ink Black pill button always paired with a ghost pill button as a matched set on the same row — the solid black lozenge is the signature action
A 4px spacing base with generous 80px section gaps and 24px-radius soft cards — the page breathes and never crowds

source.radius: 24px cards, 20px elevated cards, 16px inputs/small cards, 9999px buttons (pill)
source.shadow: subtle, barely-there — floating artifacts only: rgba(4,23,43,0.05) 0px 0px 0px 1px + rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0px 20px 25px -5px; content cards have no shadow

typographic_voice: A two-voice system: Signifier (subst. GT Sectra/Tiempos/Source Serif 4) is the display serif at weight 400 only across 44/64/90px with tight negative tracking (-2.25px at 90px) — headlines whisper authority through stroke contrast, never bold; Sohne (subst. Inter) is the workhorse sans for all body/UI using fine half-step weights (430/450/480) instead of jumping to bold; no bold display, no sans headlines, no italic in body.
